### The Faith of Joseph
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-faith-of-joseph
Passage: Hebrews 11:22
Points:
- Joseph demonstrated forward-looking faith by trusting God's exodus promise centuries before it took place.
- Despite achieving great worldly power and wealth in Egypt, he recognized his true home was with God's people.
- His request concerning his bones showed that he did not view death as a barrier to God's promises.
- Joseph's ultimate hope went beyond burial in Canaan to the future resurrection and life in God's eternal presence.
